// Hurl Spear — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"volume":0.9,"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"move":"hurl","n":4,"fly":280,"seed":4405};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{},"images":{},"sfx":{"wind4":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind4.ogg","wind7":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind7.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-masked-hurl-spear";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Hurl Spear]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Masked Girl (Kalina) kit: prepended to every masked-*.inner.js shot by legacy-masked-signatures.js ──

// Port of the approved legacy boss mockup (part-b1 + r3/r4/r5/r6 overrides). LIVE board: the camera is never

// touched; Kalina is painted by this kit from a per-shot BODY(t) state (her own art or a pose sprite), so poses,

// afterimages, ghost trails and filters all work; the real token stays hidden while the shot owns her.

// Every number is mockup px on a 1682 px stage, scaled by KP = stage width / 1682. No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

// cast focus (Zero Power): everyone else on the board becomes a timeline token so it can fade out

const BYST = [];

if (cfg.focus) {

const skip = new Set([caster.id]); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); let n = 0;

for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; const k = 'b' + (n++); BYST.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t }; }

}

const CL = A.clips || {};

// LIVE board for the on-board moves; cfg.live === false = the full-takeover timeline (camera driven through S.cam),

// used by the Zero Power cinematic only

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, clamp01 = tl.clamp01, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

// the mockup's extra easings

const X = { lin: E.lin, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, quad: E.ioQ, sine: E.sine, outCubic: E.outC, inCubic: E.inC,

outBack: (t) => { const c = 1.6; return 1 + (c + 1) * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c * Math.pow(t - 1, 2); } };

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 1357);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (did) return; did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[MG] once threw', e); } } }); };

const S_ = (at, key, v) => { const url = A.sfx && A.sfx[key]; if (url) sfx.push({ at, url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.9 : cfg.volume) }); };

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const boxB = (k) => TOK[k].y + TOK[k].h / 2; // mockup OY: the bottom of a battler's art box

const center = (k) => ({ x: TOK[k].x, y: TOK[k].y }); // mockup center(): middle of the art box

const ftOf = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

// toward the party: the first target, else the friendly tokens on the board, else her facing

const DIR = (() => {

if (FOES.length) return TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

const pcs = ((canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []).filter((t) => t && t.document && t.document.disposition === 1 && t !== caster);

if (pcs.length) return (pcs.reduce((s, t) => s + t.center.x, 0) / pcs.length) >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

return K.dir || 1;

})();

const viewTop = () => { let top = tl.STAGE.y; try { const v = tl.camView(null); if (v && Number.isFinite(v.top)) top = Math.min(top, v.top); } catch (e) {} return top; };

// ── poses: the pose system keeps the idle art's PIXEL size (scale = her drawn width / her art width) ──

const natW = (im) => (im && (im.videoWidth || im.naturalWidth || im.width)) || 0;

const natH = (im) => (im && (im.videoHeight || im.naturalHeight || im.height)) || 0;

const ART0 = tl.art('k');

const PX = K.w / (natW(ART0) || K.w);

function footOf(im) {

try { const w = natW(im), h = natH(im); if (!w || !h) return null; const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(im, 0, 0); const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;

for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0; y--) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 128) return (y + 1) / h; return null; } catch (e) { return null; }

}

const POSES = { idle: { key: 'idle', img: ART0, w: K.w, h: K.h, foot: K.foot } };

function addPose(key, img) { if (!img || !natW(img)) return; POSES[key] = { key, img, w: natW(img) * PX, h: natH(img) * PX, foot: footOf(img) || K.foot }; }

for (const k of (cfg.poses || [])) addPose(k, tl.IMG['pose_' + k]);

// the winged battler (Kalina_Battler002.webm) as a playing video

if (A.winged) {

const v = await new Promise((ok) => { const el = document.createElement('video'); el.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; el.muted = true; el.loop = true; el.playsInline = true; el.preload = 'auto';

let done = false; const fin = (r) => { if (done) return; done = true; ok(r); };

el.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => fin(el)); el.addEventListener('error', () => fin(null)); setTimeout(() => fin(el.readyState >= 2 ? el : null), 5000); el.src = A.winged; });

if (v) { try { v.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} addPose('winged', v); }

}

const poseOf = (k) => POSES[k] || POSES.idle;

// a pose's art box in board px at a body state (mockup OX/OY/hgt/wid while that art is on)

function boxOf(s) { const P = poseOf(s.pose), d = s.d || 1; const top = s.y - s.air - P.h * d * P.foot; return { x: s.x, top, bottom: top + P.h * d, h: P.h * d, w: P.w * d }; }

const handOf = (s) => { const b = boxOf(s); return { x: b.x + DIR * b.w * 0.3, y: b.bottom - b.h * 0.62 }; };

const bodyMid = (s) => { const b = boxOf(s); return { x: b.x, y: b.bottom - b.h * 0.5 }; };

// ── her body: the shot sets BODY = (t) => state; the kit paints it (afterimages and ghost trails behind) ──

const st0 = () => ({ x: kf.x, y: kf.y, air: 0, pose: 'idle', sx: 1, sy: 1, rot: 0, alpha: 1, hidden: false, filter: '', d: 1 });

let BODY = null;

const AFTER = []; // afterimages: { t0, ms, op, filter } = a snapshot of the body at t0, fading out

const TRAILS = []; // guest ghost trails: { t0, t1, n, lag, op, pose }

const HAS_SH = (() => { try { const f1 = caster.document.flags && caster.document.flags['fabula-ultima-companion']; const f2 = caster.actor && caster.actor.flags && caster.actor.flags['fabula-ultima-companion']; return !!((f1 && f1.spriteShadow) || (f2 && f2.spriteShadow)); } catch (e) { return false; } })();

const BAKE = new Map();

function baked(P, filter) {

if (!filter) return P.img; const key = P.key + '|' + filter; let c = BAKE.get(key); if (c) return c;

const w = natW(P.img), h = natH(P.img); if (!w || !h) return P.img;

c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.filter = filter; x.drawImage(P.img, 0, 0, w, h); BAKE.set(key, c); return c;

}

// depth: a body that crosses the floor is drawn at the size of where it stands

const DCACHE = new Map();

const depthAt = (x, y) => { const key = Math.round(x) + '|' + Math.round(y); let d = DCACHE.get(key); if (d == null) { d = tl.depthRatio(kf, { x, y }); DCACHE.set(key, d); } return d; };

function bodyAt(t) { const s = Object.assign(st0(), BODY ? BODY(t) : {}); s.d = (s.x !== kf.x || s.y !== kf.y) ? depthAt(s.x, s.y) : 1; return s; }

// mockup px (filter lengths) -> canvas px of the overlay under the current transform

const fpx = (g, n) => { let a = 1; try { a = g.getTransform().a; } catch (e) {} return Math.max(0, n * KP * a); };

function paint(g, s, img, a, filter) {

const P = poseOf(s.pose); g.save(); g.translate(s.x, s.y - s.air); if (s.rot) g.rotate(s.rot * Math.PI / 180);

g.scale(K.flip * s.sx * s.d, s.sy * s.d); g.globalAlpha = a; if (filter) g.filter = filter;

g.drawImage(img || P.img, -P.w / 2, -P.h * P.foot, P.w, P.h); g.restore();

}

function bodyTrack(total, z) {

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => {

if (!BODY) return; const s = bodyAt(t); const q = S.tok.k;

if (s.hidden || s.alpha <= 0) q.hidden = true;

else { q.pose = 'blank'; q.dx = s.x - kf.x; q.dy = s.y - kf.y; q.air = s.air; if (Math.abs(q.dy) > 0.5) q.noShadow = true; }

if (HAS_SH && !s.hidden && Math.abs(s.y - kf.y) > 0.5) S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const lk = Math.min(1, s.air / K.h); g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 0.32 * (1 - 0.45 * lk); g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(s.x, s.y, K.w * 0.3 * s.d * (1 - 0.35 * lk), K.w * 0.09 * s.d * (1 - 0.35 * lk), 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.restore(); } });

S.world.push({ z: z || 20, draw: (g) => {

for (const a of AFTER) { const age = t - a.t0; if (age < 0 || age >= a.ms) continue; const s2 = a.s || (a.s = bodyAt(a.t0)); if (s2.hidden) continue; paint(g, s2, baked(poseOf(s2.pose), a.filter), a.op * (1 - X.sine(age / a.ms))); }

for (const tr of TRAILS) { if (t < tr.t0 || t > tr.t1 + tr.n * tr.lag + 60) continue;

for (let i = tr.n - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const ts = t - (i + 1) * tr.lag; if (ts < tr.t0) continue; const s2 = bodyAt(ts); if (s2.hidden) continue; const u = i / Math.max(1, tr.n - 1);

const P = poseOf(tr.pose || s2.pose); paint(g, Object.assign({}, s2, { pose: P.key }), baked(P, 'brightness(' + (0.55 * (1 - u)).toFixed(3) + ') sepia(1) hue-rotate(175deg) saturate(' + (6 * (1 - u) + 0.01).toFixed(3) + ')'), tr.op); } }

if (!s.hidden && s.alpha > 0) paint(g, s, null, s.alpha, s.filter ? s.filter.replace(/\{(\d+(\.\d+)?)\}/g, (mm, n) => fpx(g, Number(n)).toFixed(2) + 'px') : '');

} });

});

}

const BLANK = document.createElement('canvas'); BLANK.width = 2; BLANK.height = 2;

(tl.POSE.k = tl.POSE.k || {}).blank = { img: BLANK, foot: 1, w: 0.01, h: 0.01 };

// afterimages every 'every' ms over [t0, t1)

const afterimages = (t0, t1, every, op, ms, filter) => { for (let t = t0; t < t1; t += every) AFTER.push({ t0: t, ms, op, filter: filter || 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)' }); };

// a value track built from tweens: segs = [t0, ms, to, ease]; a later tween takes over from where the value is

function tw(init, segs) {

const S = segs.slice().sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]); const starts = [];

const valAt = (i, t) => { if (i < 0) return init; const sg = S[i]; if (t < sg[0]) return valAt(i - 1, t); const u = sg[1] > 0 ? clamp01((t - sg[0]) / sg[1]) : 1; return lerp(starts[i], sg[2], (sg[3] || X.lin)(u)); };

for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) starts.push(i === 0 ? init : valAt(i - 1, S[i][0]));

return (t) => { let i = S.length - 1; while (i >= 0 && t < S[i][0]) i--; return valAt(i, t); };

}

// a step track: [[t, value], ...] -> the last value whose t has passed

const steps = (init, list) => (t) => { let v = init; for (const sp of list) if (t >= sp[0]) v = sp[1]; return v; };

// ── particles (world space; 'ground'/'field' sit under the real tokens, 'hit' above everything) ──

const PS = [];

const LAYER_Z = { ground: 2, field: 4, hit: 30 };

const part = (p) => { p.z = LAYER_Z[p.layer || 'hit']; PS.push(p); return p; };

function posOf(p, age) {

let dx, dy; const vx = p.vx || 0, vy = p.vy || 0;

if (p.drag && p.drag < 1) { const L = Math.log(p.drag) / 16; const f = (Math.exp(L * age) - 1) / L; dx = vx * f; dy = vy * f; } else { dx = vx * age; dy = vy * age; }

dy += 0.5 * (p.g || 0) * age * age; return { x: p.x + dx * KP, y: p.y + dy * KP };

}

function particleTrack(total) {

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => {

for (const z of [2, 4, 30]) { let any = false; for (const p of PS) if (p.z === z && t >= p.t0 && t < p.t0 + p.life) { any = true; break; } if (!any) continue;

S.world.push({ z, draw: (g) => { for (const p of PS) { if (p.z !== z) continue; const age = t - p.t0; if (age < 0 || age >= p.life) continue; const pt = p.pos ? p.pos(age) : posOf(p, age); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = p.comp || 'lighter'; p.draw(g, pt.x, pt.y, age / p.life, age, p); g.restore(); } } }); }

});

}

const glw = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// mockup ring(): an expanding floor ellipse

const ring = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', r0 = o.r0 == null ? 10 : o.r0, r1 = o.r1 == null ? 160 : o.r1, ms = o.ms || 600, sy = o.sy || 0.3, w = o.w || 6, s = o.s || 1;

part({ t0: at, life: ms, x: pt.x, y: pt.y, layer: o.layer || 'ground', draw: (g, x, y, u) => { const r = lerp(r0, r1, X.outCubic(u)) * s * KP; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (1 - u) + ')'; g.lineWidth = w * (1 - u * 0.6) * s * KP; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, r, r * sy, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.stroke(); } }); };

// mockup floorShadow(): a dark ellipse that grows under a target until 'end'

const floorShadow = (at, end, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const r = o.r || 60, grow = o.grow || 600, to = o.to == null ? 0.55 : o.to, s = o.s || 1;

part({ t0: at, life: Math.max(1, end - at), x: pt.x, y: pt.y, layer: 'ground', comp: 'source-over', draw: (g, x, y, u, age) => { const k = X.in(clamp01(age / grow)); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (to * k) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, Math.max(0.1, r * k * s * KP), Math.max(0.1, r * k * s * KP * 0.32), 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); } }); };

const crack = (at, pt, s) => { s = s || 1; const segs = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => [rnd(0, 6.2832), rnd(30, 80)]);

part({ t0: at, life: 1600, x: pt.x, y: pt.y, layer: 'ground', comp: 'source-over', draw: (g, x, y, u) => { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,18,10,' + (u > 0.7 ? (1 - u) / 0.3 * 0.8 : 0.8) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3 * s * KP; for (const sg of segs) { const a = sg[0], L = sg[1] * KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y); g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * L * s * 0.5, y + Math.sin(a) * L * s * 0.16); g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a + 0.3) * L * s, y + Math.sin(a + 0.3) * L * s * 0.32); g.stroke(); } } }); };

const dustBurst = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, s = o.s || 1, rgb = o.rgb || '190,170,140';

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), r = rnd(8, 18) * s; part({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), x: pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, y: pt.y, vx: Math.cos(an) * rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s, vy: Math.sin(an) * rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s, drag: 0.97, layer: 'field', comp: 'source-over',

draw: (g, x, y, u) => { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.45 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r * (1 + u) * KP, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); } }); } };

const twinkles = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 10, r = o.r == null ? 80 : o.r, rgb = o.rgb || '160,230,255';

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const sz = rnd(5, 11); part({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), x: pt.x + rnd(-r, r) * KP, y: pt.y + rnd(-r, r) * 0.8 * KP, layer: o.layer || 'hit',

draw: (g, x, y, u) => { const k = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * sz * KP; glw(g, x, y, k * 2.5, rgb, 0.7); g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y - k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x + k * 0.3, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x - k * 0.3, y); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 0.3); g.lineTo(x + k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y - k * 0.3); g.closePath(); g.fill(); } }); } };

// mockup windWisps(): motes curving in to a point (homing, ease-in)

const wisps = (at, to, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, r = o.r || 220, rgb = o.rgb || '200,255,225', ms = o.ms || 700, arc = 60;

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = rnd(0, 6.2832), from = { x: to.x + Math.cos(a) * r * KP, y: to.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.6 * KP }; const cx = (from.x + to.x) / 2 + rnd(-arc, arc) * KP, cy = Math.min(from.y, to.y) - rnd(arc * 0.3, arc) * KP; const life = ms * rnd(0.85, 1.15);

const at2 = (age) => { const tt = X.in(Math.min(1, age / life)), u = 1 - tt; return { x: u * u * from.x + 2 * u * tt * cx + tt * tt * to.x, y: u * u * from.y + 2 * u * tt * cy + tt * tt * to.y }; };

part({ t0: at, life, pos: at2, draw: (g, x, y, u, age) => { const pv = at2(Math.max(0, age - 16)); glw(g, x, y, 2 * 3.5 * KP, rgb, 0.95); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',.5)'; g.lineWidth = 2 * KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(pv.x, pv.y); g.lineTo(x, y); g.stroke(); } }); } };

const feathersOut = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 16, rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', spread = o.spread || 0.35, s = o.s || 1;

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(0, 6.2832), sp = rnd(0.05, spread), rot0 = rnd(0, 6), vr = rnd(-0.004, 0.004), L = rnd(9, 16) * s;

part({ t0: at, life: rnd(1100, 1900), x: pt.x, y: pt.y, vx: Math.cos(an) * sp, vy: Math.sin(an) * sp * 0.7, g: 0.00025, drag: 0.975, layer: o.layer || 'hit', comp: 'source-over',

draw: (g, x, y, u, age) => { g.globalAlpha = u > 0.6 ? (1 - u) / 0.4 : 1; g.translate(x + Math.sin(age / 260) * 5 * KP, y); g.rotate(rot0 + vr * age); const l = L * KP; g.fillStyle = 'rgb(' + rgb + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(0, 0, l, l * 0.28, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,140,170,.6)'; g.lineWidth = KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-l, 0); g.lineTo(l, 0); g.stroke(); } }); } };

const ember = (at, x, y, rgb, o) => { o = o || {}; const r = o.r || rnd(2, 5);

part(Object.assign({ t0: at, life: rnd(1400, 2600), x, y, vx: rnd(-0.03, 0.03), vy: rnd(-0.12, -0.05), layer: 'hit' }, o, { draw: (g, px, py, u, age) => { glw(g, px + Math.sin(age / 300) * 6 * KP, py, r * 3 * KP, rgb, Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * 0.9); } })); };

// ── Masked Girl (Kalina) kit: prepended to every masked-*.inner.js shot by legacy-masked-signatures.js ──

const ftOf = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

if (FOES.length) return TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

const pcs = ((canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []).filter((t) => t && t.document && t.document.disposition === 1 && t !== caster);

if (pcs.length) return (pcs.reduce((s, t) => s + t.center.x, 0) / pcs.length) >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

})();

const viewTop = () => { let top = tl.STAGE.y; try { const v = tl.camView(null); if (v && Number.isFinite(v.top)) top = Math.min(top, v.top); } catch (e) {} return top; };

// ── poses: the pose system keeps the idle art's PIXEL size (scale = her drawn width / her art width) ──

const natW = (im) => (im && (im.videoWidth || im.naturalWidth || im.width)) || 0;

const natH = (im) => (im && (im.videoHeight || im.naturalHeight || im.height)) || 0;

// Piercing Talon — PIERCE (Resolution)

// Pierce: if the action MISSES, still deal 50% damage (round up) as Physical damage.

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][PIERCE]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// --- Accuracy (pipeline-first, then args fallback) ---

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

// --- DEF snapshot (physical) ---

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.def ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

// --- Hit/Miss rule (Accuracy >= Defense) ---

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const usedDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= usedDef;

};

// --- Planned damage (same style as before) ---

const ap = p?.advPayload ?? p?.actionContext?.advPayload ?? {};

const base = parseInt(String(ap?.baseValue ?? "0").replace("+", ""), 10) || 0;

const bonus = Number(ap?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const reduction = Number(ap?.reduction ?? 0) || 0;

const multPct = Number(ap?.multiplier ?? 100) || 100;

const planned = Math.max(0, Math.floor((base + bonus - reduction) * (multPct / 100)));

const pierceDamage = Math.ceil(planned * 0.5);

if (pierceDamage <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No pierce damage to apply", { planned, pierceDamage });

return;

}

const attackerUuid = String(p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? ap?.attackerUuid ?? "");

const ADV = game.macros.getName("AdvanceDamage");

if (!ADV) return console.warn(TAG, `Macro "AdvanceDamage" not found.`);

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

for (const tuuid of targetUuids) {

const td = await fromUuid(tuuid).catch(() => null);

const targetActor = td?.actor ?? td;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const hit = isHit(tuuid, targetActor);

// HIT: do nothing

if (hit) {

console.log(TAG, "HIT — Pierce does nothing", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

def: getDef(tuuid, targetActor)

});

continue;

}

// MISS: apply 50% via AdvanceDamage

const tokenId =

(td?.documentName === "Token" || td?.documentName === "TokenDocument") ? (td?.id ?? td?._id ?? null)

: canvas?.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t?.actor?.id === targetActor.id)?.id ?? null;

if (!tokenId) {

console.warn(TAG, "MISS but cannot resolve tokenId; skipping", { target: targetActor?.name, tuuid });

continue;

}

console.log(TAG, "MISS — Applying Pierce (50%)", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

def: getDef(tuuid, targetActor),

planned,

pierceDamage

});

globalThis.__AUTO = true;

globalThis.__PAYLOAD = {

targetIds: [tokenId],

baseValue: String(pierceDamage),

bonus: 0,

reduction: 0,

multiplier: 100,

valueType: "hp",

elementType: "physical",

weaponType: "none_ef",

attackerUuid

};

await ADV.execute();

delete globalThis.__AUTO;

delete globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

}

})();

// ── Jump / Skyfall Dive / Dragonfire Dive: guest Kalina's dive code and numbers (GUEST cfg, mockup r3), mirrored for

// her side, with the new sprites (r4: dive-landing on the way down and on impact, the float pose on the arc home;

// r6: her battle sprite again the moment she touches down, then the slide). cfg.move = 'jump' | 'skyfall' | 'dragonfire'.

// The token contract kept from the shipped Jump / Skyfall Dive: Jump leaves her token at alpha 0 (hidden while Flying,

// persisted on the TokenDocument by one GM); Skyfall Dive starts hidden and sets it back to 1 when she lands.

const MOVE = cfg.move, G = cfg.guest;

const top = viewTop();

const liftOff = (y) => (y - top) + 340 * KP; // mockup OY(t) + 340: from her floor row to above the frame

let total = 0, gate = 0;

if (MOVE === 'jump') {

// a quick crouch (squash to 80 %), then she launches off the top of the frame

const C0 = G.squashMs, C1 = C0 + G.holdMs, C2 = C1 + G.releaseMs, UP = C2 + G.upMs;

const syT = tw(1, [[0, G.squashMs, G.squash, X.outCubic], [C1, G.releaseMs, 1, X.inCubic]]);

const airT = tw(0, [[C2, G.upMs, liftOff(kf.y), X.outCubic]]);

BODY = (t) => ({ sy: syT(t), air: airT(t), hidden: t >= UP });

S_(C2, 'jump2', 0.5); dustBurst(C2, kf, { n: 8 });

// hidden while Flying: every client drops its mesh to 0 as she leaves the frame, one GM persists it

once(UP, () => tokenAlpha(caster, 0));

gate = UP; total = UP + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'skyfall' || MOVE === 'dragonfire') {

const winged = MOVE === 'dragonfire';

const tk = FOES[0] || null;

// Skyfall: she is already up there (hidden since Jump), a hold in the sky. Dragonfire: take off in the winged form first.

let D0 = G.peakMs, airUp = null;

if (winged) { const up = tw(0, [[0, G.upMs, liftOff(kf.y), X.outCubic]]); airUp = (t) => up(t); D0 = G.upMs + Math.round(G.peakMs * 0.6); S_(0, 'wind1', 0.5); }

if (!tk) {

// no target: nothing to dive at; bring her back as she is

BODY = (t) => (winged ? { pose: 'winged', air: airUp(t), hidden: t >= G.upMs } : { hidden: true });

if (!winged) once(0, () => tokenAlpha(caster, 1));

total = winged ? G.upMs + 300 : 300; gate = total;

} else {

const tf = ftOf(tk), home = { x: kf.x, y: kf.y };

const startX = tf.x - DIR * G.lateral * KP, hitX = tf.x - DIR * 30 * KP;

const IMP = D0 + G.diveMs, BACK0 = IMP + 140, LAND = BACK0 + G.backMs, SLID = LAND + G.slideMs, STOP = SLID + G.ghosts * G.lagMs + 60;

const landX = lerp(tf.x, home.x, G.landFrac), l0 = liftOff(tf.y);

const pDown = winged ? 'winged' : 'diveland', pBack = winged ? 'winged' : 'jump', pLand = winged ? 'winged' : 'idle';

BODY = (t) => {

if (t < D0) return winged ? { pose: 'winged', air: airUp(t), hidden: t >= G.upMs } : { hidden: true };

if (t < IMP) { const u = X.inCubic(seg(t, D0, IMP)); return { pose: pDown, x: lerp(startX, hitX, u), y: tf.y, air: lerp(l0, 0, u) }; }

if (t < BACK0) return { pose: pDown, x: hitX, y: tf.y };

if (t < LAND) { const u = seg(t, BACK0, LAND); return { pose: pBack, x: lerp(hitX, landX, u), y: lerp(tf.y, home.y, u), air: G.apex * 4 * u * (1 - u) * KP }; }

return { pose: pLand, x: lerp(landX, home.x, X.outCubic(seg(t, LAND, SLID))), y: home.y };

};

// five-ghost blue-to-black trail from the dive start until she settles

TRAILS.push({ t0: D0, t1: SLID, n: G.ghosts, lag: G.lagMs, op: G.ghostA, pose: pDown });

S_(D0, 'wind7', 0.5);

const tc = center(tk);

if (!winged) {

fx('impact10', IMP, tc, 1.4, { z: 40 }); S_(IMP, 'hitslashb', 0.7); shake(IMP, 10, 300);

} else {

const tb = boxB(tk), th = TOK[tk].h;

fx('fireball', IMP, { x: tf.x, y: tb - th * 0.35 }, 1.5, { z: 40 });

fx('bomb', IMP, tf, 1.2, { z: 41, add: true });

fx('bombBottom', IMP, tf, 1.2, { z: 3, add: true });

flashC(IMP, '#ffb060', 0.5, 30, 260); shake(IMP, 22, 520); ring(IMP, tf, { rgb: '255,160,60', r1: 320, w: 12, ms: 700 });

for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) ember(IMP, tf.x + rnd(-120, 120) * KP, tf.y - rnd(0, 120) * KP, '255,140,50', { vy: -rnd(0.1, 0.3), r: rnd(3, 7) });

S_(IMP, 'explosion2', 0.7); S_(IMP, 'fire3', 0.5);

}

// the contact: the game shows the hurt, the flinch and the numbers (splash targets included)

once(IMP, () => oni.hit());

// feet on the ground: battle sprite again, a puff of dust, then the slide home; Skyfall hands her back to the token

dustBurst(LAND, { x: landX, y: home.y }, { n: 6 });

if (!winged) once(LAND, () => tokenAlpha(caster, 1));

gate = STOP; total = STOP + (winged ? 500 : 300);

}

}

await runShot(total, gate);

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Dragonfire Dive" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();
props.custom_logic_resolution:
// ============================================================================

// Custom Logic - Resolution : Dragonfire Dive (Proximity Splash AOE)

// "Deals 50% of the damage to adjacent creature(s)"

// - Splash area is computed from your JRPG layout points (no fixed slot matching)

// - Deals splash to ALL tokens inside radius (excluding the main target)

// - Applies damage by injecting payload into AdvanceDamage (AUTO mode)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][DragonfireDive][SplashAOE]";

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// Helpers

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);

const getCenter = (tok) => {

if (tok?.center) return { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const d = tok?.document ?? tok;

const w = (d?.width ?? 1) * (canvas?.grid?.size ?? 100);

const h = (d?.height ?? 1) * (canvas?.grid?.size ?? 100);

return { x: (d?.x ?? 0) + w / 2, y: (d?.y ?? 0) + h / 2 };

};

const toNum = (v, d = 0) => {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : d;

};

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 1) Resolve MAIN target token (first target)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const mainTargetUuid = targetUuids[0];

if (!mainTargetUuid) return console.warn(TAG, "No main target in payload.targets");

const mainTargetDoc = await fromUuid(mainTargetUuid);

const mainTargetToken = mainTargetDoc?.object ?? mainTargetDoc; // TokenDocument -> Token

if (!mainTargetToken) return console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve main target token", mainTargetUuid);

const origin = getCenter(mainTargetToken);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 2) Read "damage dealt" from pipeline (best-effort)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? {};

let dealt =

toNum(p?.meta?.finalDamageDealt ?? p?.meta?.damageDealt ?? p?.damageDealt ??

args?.finalDamageDealt ?? args?.damageDealt ?? args?.finalDamage ?? 0, 0);

// Fallback: if your pipeline carries an "advPayload"-like object

if (dealt <= 0) {

const ap = args?.advPayload ?? p?.advPayload ?? {};

const base = parseInt(String(ap?.baseValue ?? "0").replace("+", ""), 10) || 0;

const bonus = toNum(ap?.bonus, 0);

const reduction = toNum(ap?.reduction, 0);

const multPct = toNum(ap?.multiplier, 100);

dealt = Math.max(0, Math.floor((base + bonus - reduction) * (multPct / 100)));

}

if (dealt <= 0) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not determine dealt damage (all sources were 0). Aborting splash.", {

meta: p?.meta,

argsKeys: Object.keys(args ?? {}),

advPayload: args?.advPayload ?? p?.advPayload

});

return;

}

const splash = Math.ceil(dealt * 0.5);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 3) Compute splash radius from YOUR layout points

// Goal: include "adjacent" spacing, exclude "two slots away"

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const LAYOUT = [

{ x: 790, y: 203 },

{ x: 887, y: 261 },

{ x: 985, y: 320 },

{ x: 1082, y: 378 },

];

// Adjacent distances (1-2, 2-3, 3-4)

const adj = [

dist(LAYOUT[0], LAYOUT[1]),

dist(LAYOUT[1], LAYOUT[2]),

dist(LAYOUT[2], LAYOUT[3]),

];

const maxAdj = Math.max(...adj);

// Two-steps-away distances (1-3, 2-4) -> this is what we must NOT reach

const skip = [

dist(LAYOUT[0], LAYOUT[2]),

dist(LAYOUT[1], LAYOUT[3]),

];

const minSkip = Math.min(...skip);

// Radius = midpoint between "adjacent max" and "two-away min"

// + tiny buffer so adjacent always counts, but still safely under 2-away

const radius = Math.floor(((maxAdj + minSkip) / 2) * 0.98);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 4) Find ALL tokens within radius of main target (exclude main target)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const allTokens = canvas?.tokens?.placeables ?? [];

const splashTargets = allTokens.filter(t => {

if (!t?.actor) return false; // must be a creature token

if (t.document?.uuid === mainTargetToken.document?.uuid) return false; // exclude main target

const c = getCenter(t);

return dist(origin, c) <= radius;

});

if (splashTargets.length === 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No tokens inside splash radius.", {

mainTarget: mainTargetToken?.name,

radius,

dealt,

splash

});

return;

}

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 5) Inject payload into AdvanceDamage to apply splash properly

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const ADV = game.macros.getName("AdvanceDamage");

if (!ADV) {

ui.notifications.error("AdvanceDamage macro not found (name must be exactly: AdvanceDamage).");

return;

}

// Best-effort passthrough of context (so logs/affinity behave like the main hit)

const attackerUuid =

(p?.attackerUuid ?? p?.actionContext?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? "").toString();

const elementType =

(p?.elementType ?? p?.actionContext?.elementType ?? p?.advPayload?.elementType ?? p?.meta?.elementType ?? "elementless").toString();

const weaponType =

(p?.weaponType ?? p?.actionContext?.weaponType ?? p?.advPayload?.weaponType ?? p?.meta?.weaponType ?? "none_ef").toString();

// IMPORTANT: AdvanceDamage supports headless targeting via PAYLOAD.targetIds when AUTO is true.

// It accepts token IDs (t.id or t.document.id). We'll use t.id.

const targetIds = splashTargets.map(t => t.id);

const advPayload = {

// headless mode

targetIds,

// damage inputs

baseValue: String(splash), // "N" = damage, "+N" = heal

reduction: 0,

bonus: 0,

multiplier: 100,

// damage context

valueType: "hp",

targetAffinity: "neutral",

ignoreDamageReduction: false,

ignoreShield: false,

// pass through so your logs/cards show correct source & element

attackerUuid,

elementType,

weaponType,

// carry full context if you want cards to show it

actionContext: p?.actionContext ?? null,

attackerName: p?.attackerName ?? p?.attacker ?? "None",

attackRange: p?.attackRange ?? "None",

sourceType: p?.sourceType ?? "None",

};

// ✅ NEW: wait 1500ms before dealing splash damage

await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));

// Your system convention: inject as globals, then execute macro.

globalThis.__AUTO = true;

globalThis.__PAYLOAD = advPayload;

try {

await ADV.execute();

} finally {

// clean up so we don't leak headless state to other macros

try { delete globalThis.__AUTO; } catch (e) {}

try { delete globalThis.__PAYLOAD; } catch (e) {}

}

console.log(TAG, "Splash applied via AdvanceDamage", {

mainTarget: mainTargetToken?.name,

dealt,

splash,

radius,

splashTargets: splashTargets.map(t => t.name)

});

})();

// Spear — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

(async () => {

const CFG = {"casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"volume":0.9,"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"move":"spear","seed":4408};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"pierce":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/011_pierce_physical.webm","w":660,"h":660,"dur":467,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.503,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"images":{},"sfx":{"swingA":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGA.wav","hitpierceb":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_PiercingB.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-masked-spear";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Spear]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Masked Girl (Kalina) kit: prepended to every masked-*.inner.js shot by legacy-masked-signatures.js ──

// Port of the approved legacy boss mockup (part-b1 + r3/r4/r5/r6 overrides). LIVE board: the camera is never

// touched; Kalina is painted by this kit from a per-shot BODY(t) state (her own art or a pose sprite), so poses,

// afterimages, ghost trails and filters all work; the real token stays hidden while the shot owns her.

// Every number is mockup px on a 1682 px stage, scaled by KP = stage width / 1682. No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

// cast focus (Zero Power): everyone else on the board becomes a timeline token so it can fade out

const BYST = [];

if (cfg.focus) {

const skip = new Set([caster.id]); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); let n = 0;

for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; const k = 'b' + (n++); BYST.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t }; }

}

const CL = A.clips || {};

// LIVE board for the on-board moves; cfg.live === false = the full-takeover timeline (camera driven through S.cam),

// used by the Zero Power cinematic only

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, clamp01 = tl.clamp01, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

// the mockup's extra easings

const X = { lin: E.lin, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, quad: E.ioQ, sine: E.sine, outCubic: E.outC, inCubic: E.inC,

outBack: (t) => { const c = 1.6; return 1 + (c + 1) * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c * Math.pow(t - 1, 2); } };

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 1357);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (did) return; did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[MG] once threw', e); } } }); };

const S_ = (at, key, v) => { const url = A.sfx && A.sfx[key]; if (url) sfx.push({ at, url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.9 : cfg.volume) }); };

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const boxB = (k) => TOK[k].y + TOK[k].h / 2; // mockup OY: the bottom of a battler's art box

const center = (k) => ({ x: TOK[k].x, y: TOK[k].y }); // mockup center(): middle of the art box

const ftOf = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

// toward the party: the first target, else the friendly tokens on the board, else her facing

const DIR = (() => {

if (FOES.length) return TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

const pcs = ((canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []).filter((t) => t && t.document && t.document.disposition === 1 && t !== caster);

if (pcs.length) return (pcs.reduce((s, t) => s + t.center.x, 0) / pcs.length) >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

return K.dir || 1;

})();

const viewTop = () => { let top = tl.STAGE.y; try { const v = tl.camView(null); if (v && Number.isFinite(v.top)) top = Math.min(top, v.top); } catch (e) {} return top; };

// ── poses: the pose system keeps the idle art's PIXEL size (scale = her drawn width / her art width) ──

const natW = (im) => (im && (im.videoWidth || im.naturalWidth || im.width)) || 0;

const natH = (im) => (im && (im.videoHeight || im.naturalHeight || im.height)) || 0;

const ART0 = tl.art('k');

const PX = K.w / (natW(ART0) || K.w);

function footOf(im) {

try { const w = natW(im), h = natH(im); if (!w || !h) return null; const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(im, 0, 0); const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;

for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0; y--) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 128) return (y + 1) / h; return null; } catch (e) { return null; }

}

const POSES = { idle: { key: 'idle', img: ART0, w: K.w, h: K.h, foot: K.foot } };

function addPose(key, img) { if (!img || !natW(img)) return; POSES[key] = { key, img, w: natW(img) * PX, h: natH(img) * PX, foot: footOf(img) || K.foot }; }

for (const k of (cfg.poses || [])) addPose(k, tl.IMG['pose_' + k]);

// the winged battler (Kalina_Battler002.webm) as a playing video

if (A.winged) {

const v = await new Promise((ok) => { const el = document.createElement('video'); el.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; el.muted = true; el.loop = true; el.playsInline = true; el.preload = 'auto';

let done = false; const fin = (r) => { if (done) return; done = true; ok(r); };

el.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => fin(el)); el.addEventListener('error', () => fin(null)); setTimeout(() => fin(el.readyState >= 2 ? el : null), 5000); el.src = A.winged; });

if (v) { try { v.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} addPose('winged', v); }

}

const poseOf = (k) => POSES[k] || POSES.idle;

// a pose's art box in board px at a body state (mockup OX/OY/hgt/wid while that art is on)

function boxOf(s) { const P = poseOf(s.pose), d = s.d || 1; const top = s.y - s.air - P.h * d * P.foot; return { x: s.x, top, bottom: top + P.h * d, h: P.h * d, w: P.w * d }; }

const handOf = (s) => { const b = boxOf(s); return { x: b.x + DIR * b.w * 0.3, y: b.bottom - b.h * 0.62 }; };

const bodyMid = (s) => { const b = boxOf(s); return { x: b.x, y: b.bottom - b.h * 0.5 }; };

// ── her body: the shot sets BODY = (t) => state; the kit paints it (afterimages and ghost trails behind) ──

const st0 = () => ({ x: kf.x, y: kf.y, air: 0, pose: 'idle', sx: 1, sy: 1, rot: 0, alpha: 1, hidden: false, filter: '', d: 1 });

let BODY = null;

const AFTER = []; // afterimages: { t0, ms, op, filter } = a snapshot of the body at t0, fading out

const TRAILS = []; // guest ghost trails: { t0, t1, n, lag, op, pose }

const HAS_SH = (() => { try { const f1 = caster.document.flags && caster.document.flags['fabula-ultima-companion']; const f2 = caster.actor && caster.actor.flags && caster.actor.flags['fabula-ultima-companion']; return !!((f1 && f1.spriteShadow) || (f2 && f2.spriteShadow)); } catch (e) { return false; } })();

const BAKE = new Map();

function baked(P, filter) {

if (!filter) return P.img; const key = P.key + '|' + filter; let c = BAKE.get(key); if (c) return c;

const w = natW(P.img), h = natH(P.img); if (!w || !h) return P.img;

c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.filter = filter; x.drawImage(P.img, 0, 0, w, h); BAKE.set(key, c); return c;

}

// depth: a body that crosses the floor is drawn at the size of where it stands

const DCACHE = new Map();

const depthAt = (x, y) => { const key = Math.round(x) + '|' + Math.round(y); let d = DCACHE.get(key); if (d == null) { d = tl.depthRatio(kf, { x, y }); DCACHE.set(key, d); } return d; };

function bodyAt(t) { const s = Object.assign(st0(), BODY ? BODY(t) : {}); s.d = (s.x !== kf.x || s.y !== kf.y) ? depthAt(s.x, s.y) : 1; return s; }

// mockup moveActor trail .25: an afterimage each quarter of the (eased) dash

for (const u of [0.354, 0.5, 0.646]) AFTER.push({ t0: DASH * u, ms: 380, op: 0.5, filter: 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)' });

S_(HIT, 'swingA', 0.5); S_(HIT, 'hitpierceb', 0.5);

fx('pierce', HIT, center(tk), 1, { z: 30 });

once(HIT, () => oni.hit());

gate = HIT; total = END;

}

if (MOVE === 'roar') {

// full-screen dim, she rears up, roar shockwaves roll over the party, then a debuff beat on each

const ROAR = 300, RINGS = ROAR + 3 * 170, HITS = RINGS + Math.max(1, FOES.length) * 60, AFTERH = HITS + 300, SETTLE = AFTERH + 300;

const sxT = tw(1, [[0, 300, 0.96, X.out], [ROAR, 120, 1.05, X.out], [AFTERH, 300, 1, X.out]]);

const syT = tw(1, [[0, 300, 1.1, X.out], [ROAR, 120, 0.95, X.out], [AFTERH, 300, 1, X.out]]);

const rotT = tw(0, [[0, 300, lean(8), X.out], [ROAR, 120, lean(-6), X.out], [AFTERH, 300, 0, X.out]]);

BODY = (t) => ({ sx: sxT(t), sy: syT(t), rot: rotT(t) });

dimLevel(tw(0, [[0, 400, 0.45, X.sine], [AFTERH, 400, 0, X.sine]]), SETTLE + 400);

S_(ROAR, 'monster5', 0.6); rumble(ROAR, AFTERH, 4);

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const at = ROAR + i * 170; ring(at, bodyMid(bodyAt(at)), { layer: 'field', r1: 1200, ms: 900, sy: 0.55, w: 10, rgb: '255,240,220' }); }

// one contact for the whole party (the game flinches everyone hit), then the debuff beat on each

once(RINGS, () => oni.hit());

for (const k of FOES) fx('powerdown', AFTERH, ftOf(k), 1, { z: 26 });

gate = AFTERH; total = SETTLE + 400;

}

await runShot(total, gate);

`;

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

const result = await waitDone;

})();

// Spear Rain — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/legacy-masked-signatures.js (spearRain)

(async () => {

const CFG = {"move":"rain","gap":230,"plunge":120,"hitsTotal":3,"hits":[360,590,820],"casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"volume":0.9,"seed":4410,"totalTimeoutMs":17020};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"wind":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/091_wind_one_1.webm","w":508,"h":510,"dur":1000,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.8529,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"images":{},"sfx":{"wind7":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind7.ogg","hitpierceb":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_PiercingB.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-masked-spear-rain";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Spear Rain]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));

// ── shipped logic: AdvanceDamage in the global __PAYLOAD convention ──

async function runAdvanceDamageHeadless(dmgPayload) {

const ADV = game.macros.getName('AdvanceDamage');

if (!ADV) throw new Error('Macro not found: AdvanceDamage');

const prevAUTO = globalThis.__AUTO;

const prevPAYLOAD = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

try { globalThis.__AUTO = true; globalThis.__PAYLOAD = dmgPayload; return await ADV.execute(); }

finally { globalThis.__AUTO = prevAUTO; globalThis.__PAYLOAD = prevPAYLOAD; }

}

// legit targets = disposition 1 tokens on the current scene

const legitTargets = (canvas.tokens?.placeables ?? []).filter((_token) => _token?.document?.disposition === 1);

if (!legitTargets.length) { ui.notifications.warn('No legit targets found (disposition === 1) on this scene.'); return; }

const attackerUuid = P?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? P?.attackerUuid ?? P?.attacker_uuid ?? '';

const attackerName = P?.meta?.attackerName ?? P?.attackerName ?? P?.attacker ?? 'None';

const pickRandom = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

const picks = CFG.hits.map(() => pickRandom(legitTargets));

const pickUuids = picks.map((t) => t.document.uuid);

const uniqueUuids = Array.from(new Set(pickUuids));

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Masked Girl (Kalina) kit: prepended to every masked-*.inner.js shot by legacy-masked-signatures.js ──

// Port of the approved legacy boss mockup (part-b1 + r3/r4/r5/r6 overrides). LIVE board: the camera is never

// touched; Kalina is painted by this kit from a per-shot BODY(t) state (her own art or a pose sprite), so poses,

// afterimages, ghost trails and filters all work; the real token stays hidden while the shot owns her.

// Every number is mockup px on a 1682 px stage, scaled by KP = stage width / 1682. No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

// cast focus (Zero Power): everyone else on the board becomes a timeline token so it can fade out

const BYST = [];

if (cfg.focus) {

const skip = new Set([caster.id]); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); let n = 0;

for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; const k = 'b' + (n++); BYST.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t }; }

}

const CL = A.clips || {};

// LIVE board for the on-board moves; cfg.live === false = the full-takeover timeline (camera driven through S.cam),

// used by the Zero Power cinematic only

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, clamp01 = tl.clamp01, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

// the mockup's extra easings

const X = { lin: E.lin, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, quad: E.ioQ, sine: E.sine, outCubic: E.outC, inCubic: E.inC,

outBack: (t) => { const c = 1.6; return 1 + (c + 1) * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c * Math.pow(t - 1, 2); } };

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 1357);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (did) return; did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[MG] once threw', e); } } }); };

const S_ = (at, key, v) => { const url = A.sfx && A.sfx[key]; if (url) sfx.push({ at, url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.9 : cfg.volume) }); };

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const boxB = (k) => TOK[k].y + TOK[k].h / 2; // mockup OY: the bottom of a battler's art box

const center = (k) => ({ x: TOK[k].x, y: TOK[k].y }); // mockup center(): middle of the art box

const ftOf = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

// toward the party: the first target, else the friendly tokens on the board, else her facing

const DIR = (() => {

if (FOES.length) return TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

const pcs = ((canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []).filter((t) => t && t.document && t.document.disposition === 1 && t !== caster);

if (pcs.length) return (pcs.reduce((s, t) => s + t.center.x, 0) / pcs.length) >= K.x ? 1 : -1;

return K.dir || 1;

})();

const viewTop = () => { let top = tl.STAGE.y; try { const v = tl.camView(null); if (v && Number.isFinite(v.top)) top = Math.min(top, v.top); } catch (e) {} return top; };

// ── poses: the pose system keeps the idle art's PIXEL size (scale = her drawn width / her art width) ──

const natW = (im) => (im && (im.videoWidth || im.naturalWidth || im.width)) || 0;

const natH = (im) => (im && (im.videoHeight || im.naturalHeight || im.height)) || 0;

const ART0 = tl.art('k');

const PX = K.w / (natW(ART0) || K.w);

function footOf(im) {

try { const w = natW(im), h = natH(im); if (!w || !h) return null; const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(im, 0, 0); const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;

for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0; y--) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 128) return (y + 1) / h; return null; } catch (e) { return null; }

}

const POSES = { idle: { key: 'idle', img: ART0, w: K.w, h: K.h, foot: K.foot } };

function addPose(key, img) { if (!img || !natW(img)) return; POSES[key] = { key, img, w: natW(img) * PX, h: natH(img) * PX, foot: footOf(img) || K.foot }; }

for (const k of (cfg.poses || [])) addPose(k, tl.IMG['pose_' + k]);

// the winged battler (Kalina_Battler002.webm) as a playing video

if (A.winged) {

const v = await new Promise((ok) => { const el = document.createElement('video'); el.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; el.muted = true; el.loop = true; el.playsInline = true; el.preload = 'auto';

let done = false; const fin = (r) => { if (done) return; done = true; ok(r); };

el.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => fin(el)); el.addEventListener('error', () => fin(null)); setTimeout(() => fin(el.readyState >= 2 ? el : null), 5000); el.src = A.winged; });

if (v) { try { v.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} addPose('winged', v); }

}

const poseOf = (k) => POSES[k] || POSES.idle;

// a pose's art box in board px at a body state (mockup OX/OY/hgt/wid while that art is on)

function boxOf(s) { const P = poseOf(s.pose), d = s.d || 1; const top = s.y - s.air - P.h * d * P.foot; return { x: s.x, top, bottom: top + P.h * d, h: P.h * d, w: P.w * d }; }

const handOf = (s) => { const b = boxOf(s); return { x: b.x + DIR * b.w * 0.3, y: b.bottom - b.h * 0.62 }; };

const bodyMid = (s) => { const b = boxOf(s); return { x: b.x, y: b.bottom - b.h * 0.5 }; };

// ── her body: the shot sets BODY = (t) => state; the kit paints it (afterimages and ghost trails behind) ──

const st0 = () => ({ x: kf.x, y: kf.y, air: 0, pose: 'idle', sx: 1, sy: 1, rot: 0, alpha: 1, hidden: false, filter: '', d: 1 });

let BODY = null;

const AFTER = []; // afterimages: { t0, ms, op, filter } = a snapshot of the body at t0, fading out

const TRAILS = []; // guest ghost trails: { t0, t1, n, lag, op, pose }

const HAS_SH = (() => { try { const f1 = caster.document.flags && caster.document.flags['fabula-ultima-companion']; const f2 = caster.actor && caster.actor.flags && caster.actor.flags['fabula-ultima-companion']; return !!((f1 && f1.spriteShadow) || (f2 && f2.spriteShadow)); } catch (e) { return false; } })();

const BAKE = new Map();

function baked(P, filter) {

if (!filter) return P.img; const key = P.key + '|' + filter; let c = BAKE.get(key); if (c) return c;

const w = natW(P.img), h = natH(P.img); if (!w || !h) return P.img;

c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.filter = filter; x.drawImage(P.img, 0, 0, w, h); BAKE.set(key, c); return c;

}

// depth: a body that crosses the floor is drawn at the size of where it stands

const DCACHE = new Map();

const depthAt = (x, y) => { const key = Math.round(x) + '|' + Math.round(y); let d = DCACHE.get(key); if (d == null) { d = tl.depthRatio(kf, { x, y }); DCACHE.set(key, d); } return d; };

function bodyAt(t) { const s = Object.assign(st0(), BODY ? BODY(t) : {}); s.d = (s.x !== kf.x || s.y !== kf.y) ? depthAt(s.x, s.y) : 1; return s; }

// mockup px (filter lengths) -> canvas px of the overlay under the current transform

const fpx = (g, n) => { let a = 1; try { a = g.getTransform().a; } catch (e) {} return Math.max(0, n * KP * a); };

function paint(g, s, img, a, filter) {

const P = poseOf(s.pose); g.save(); g.translate(s.x, s.y - s.air); if (s.rot) g.rotate(s.rot * Math.PI / 180);

g.scale(K.flip * s.sx * s.d, s.sy * s.d); g.globalAlpha = a; if (filter) g.filter = filter;

g.drawImage(img || P.img, -P.w / 2, -P.h * P.foot, P.w, P.h); g.restore();

}

function bodyTrack(total, z) {

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => {

if (!BODY) return; const s = bodyAt(t); const q = S.tok.k;

if (s.hidden || s.alpha <= 0) q.hidden = true;

else { q.pose = 'blank'; q.dx = s.x - kf.x; q.dy = s.y - kf.y; q.air = s.air; if (Math.abs(q.dy) > 0.5) q.noShadow = true; }

if (HAS_SH && !s.hidden && Math.abs(s.y - kf.y) > 0.5) S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const lk = Math.min(1, s.air / K.h); g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 0.32 * (1 - 0.45 * lk); g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(s.x, s.y, K.w * 0.3 * s.d * (1 - 0.35 * lk), K.w * 0.09 * s.d * (1 - 0.35 * lk), 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.restore(); } });

S.world.push({ z: z || 20, draw: (g) => {

for (const a of AFTER) { const age = t - a.t0; if (age < 0 || age >= a.ms) continue; const s2 = a.s || (a.s = bodyAt(a.t0)); if (s2.hidden) continue; paint(g, s2, baked(poseOf(s2.pose), a.filter), a.op * (1 - X.sine(age / a.ms))); }

for (const tr of TRAILS) { if (t < tr.t0 || t > tr.t1 + tr.n * tr.lag + 60) continue;

for (let i = tr.n - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const ts = t - (i + 1) * tr.lag; if (ts < tr.t0) continue; const s2 = bodyAt(ts); if (s2.hidden) continue; const u = i / Math.max(1, tr.n - 1);

const P = poseOf(tr.pose || s2.pose); paint(g, Object.assign({}, s2, { pose: P.key }), baked(P, 'brightness(' + (0.55 * (1 - u)).toFixed(3) + ') sepia(1) hue-rotate(175deg) saturate(' + (6 * (1 - u) + 0.01).toFixed(3) + ')'), tr.op); } }

if (!s.hidden && s.alpha > 0) paint(g, s, null, s.alpha, s.filter ? s.filter.replace(/\{(\d+(\.\d+)?)\}/g, (mm, n) => fpx(g, Number(n)).toFixed(2) + 'px') : '');

} });

});

}

const BLANK = document.createElement('canvas'); BLANK.width = 2; BLANK.height = 2;

(tl.POSE.k = tl.POSE.k || {}).blank = { img: BLANK, foot: 1, w: 0.01, h: 0.01 };

// afterimages every 'every' ms over [t0, t1)

const afterimages = (t0, t1, every, op, ms, filter) => { for (let t = t0; t < t1; t += every) AFTER.push({ t0: t, ms, op, filter: filter || 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)' }); };

// a value track built from tweens: segs = [t0, ms, to, ease]; a later tween takes over from where the value is

function tw(init, segs) {

const S = segs.slice().sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]); const starts = [];

const valAt = (i, t) => { if (i < 0) return init; const sg = S[i]; if (t < sg[0]) return valAt(i - 1, t); const u = sg[1] > 0 ? clamp01((t - sg[0]) / sg[1]) : 1; return lerp(starts[i], sg[2], (sg[3] || X.lin)(u)); };

for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) starts.push(i === 0 ? init : valAt(i - 1, S[i][0]));

return (t) => { let i = S.length - 1; while (i >= 0 && t < S[i][0]) i--; return valAt(i, t); };

}

// a step track: [[t, value], ...] -> the last value whose t has passed

const steps = (init, list) => (t) => { let v = init; for (const sp of list) if (t >= sp[0]) v = sp[1]; return v; };

// ── particles (world space; 'ground'/'field' sit under the real tokens, 'hit' above everything) ──

const PS = [];

const LAYER_Z = { ground: 2, field: 4, hit: 30 };

const part = (p) => { p.z = LAYER_Z[p.layer || 'hit']; PS.push(p); return p; };

function posOf(p, age) {

let dx, dy; const vx = p.vx || 0, vy = p.vy || 0;

if (p.drag && p.drag < 1) { const L = Math.log(p.drag) / 16; const f = (Math.exp(L * age) - 1) / L; dx = vx * f; dy = vy * f; } else { dx = vx * age; dy = vy * age; }

dy += 0.5 * (p.g || 0) * age * age; return { x: p.x + dx * KP, y: p.y + dy * KP };

}

function particleTrack(total) {

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => {

for (const z of [2, 4, 30]) { let any = false; for (const p of PS) if (p.z === z && t >= p.t0 && t < p.t0 + p.life) { any = true; break; } if (!any) continue;

S.world.push({ z, draw: (g) => { for (const p of PS) { if (p.z !== z) continue; const age = t - p.t0; if (age < 0 || age >= p.life) continue; const pt = p.pos ? p.pos(age) : posOf(p, age); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = p.comp || 'lighter'; p.draw(g, pt.x, pt.y, age / p.life, age, p); g.restore(); } } }); }

});

}

const glw = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// mockup ring(): an expanding floor ellipse

const ring = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', r0 = o.r0 == null ? 10 : o.r0, r1 = o.r1 == null ? 160 : o.r1, ms = o.ms || 600, sy = o.sy || 0.3, w = o.w || 6, s = o.s || 1;

part({ t0: at, life: ms, x: pt.x, y: pt.y, layer: o.layer || 'ground', draw: (g, x, y, u) => { const r = lerp(r0, r1, X.outCubic(u)) * s * KP; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (1 - u) + ')'; g.lineWidth = w * (1 - u * 0.6) * s * KP; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, r, r * sy, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.stroke(); } }); };

// mockup floorShadow(): a dark ellipse that grows under a target until 'end'

const floorShadow = (at, end, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const r = o.r || 60, grow = o.grow || 600, to = o.to == null ? 0.55 : o.to, s = o.s || 1;

part({ t0: at, life: Math.max(1, end - at), x: pt.x, y: pt.y, layer: 'ground', comp: 'source-over', draw: (g, x, y, u, age) => { const k = X.in(clamp01(age / grow)); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (to * k) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, Math.max(0.1, r * k * s * KP), Math.max(0.1, r * k * s * KP * 0.32), 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); } }); };

const crack = (at, pt, s) => { s = s || 1; const segs = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => [rnd(0, 6.2832), rnd(30, 80)]);

part({ t0: at, life: 1600, x: pt.x, y: pt.y, layer: 'ground', comp: 'source-over', draw: (g, x, y, u) => { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,18,10,' + (u > 0.7 ? (1 - u) / 0.3 * 0.8 : 0.8) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3 * s * KP; for (const sg of segs) { const a = sg[0], L = sg[1] * KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y); g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * L * s * 0.5, y + Math.sin(a) * L * s * 0.16); g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a + 0.3) * L * s, y + Math.sin(a + 0.3) * L * s * 0.32); g.stroke(); } } }); };

const dustBurst = (at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, s = o.s || 1, rgb = o.rgb || '190,170,140';

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), r = rnd(8, 18) * s; part({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), x: pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, y: pt.y, vx: Math.cos(an) * rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s, vy: Math.sin(an) * rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s, drag: 0.97, layer: 'field', comp: 'source-over',

// ── Hurl Spear / Spear Rain / Piercing Talon / Wind Lance (mockup b1, the wind-imbued r2 spears).

// cfg.move = 'hurl' | 'rain' | 'talon' | 'lance'. Lean values are the mockup's (deg); positive leans her back,

// Wind Lance — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"wind":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/091_wind_one_1.webm","w":508,"h":510,"dur":1000,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.8529,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"images":{},"sfx":{"wind4":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind4.ogg","wind1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind1.ogg","hitpierceb":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_PiercingB.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-masked-wind-lance";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Wind Lance]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,255,190,' + (0.75 - i * 0.15) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 2.2; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(-26 - i * 32, 0, 9, 15, 0, age / 35 + i, age / 35 + i + 3.6); g.stroke(); }

[] : FOES)) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / Math.max(1, ms); else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / Math.max(1, backMs)); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } }); };

// edge, left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out 650 ms), hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in 650 ms); Overdrive is a sfx cue ──

const bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const f = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= f / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

const cutin = (at, key) => { const inMs = 650, hold = 850, outMs = 650, end = inMs + hold + outMs;

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

const isHostGM = () => { const u = game.user; if (!u || !u.isGM) return false; const a = game.users && game.users.activeGM; return a ? a.id === u.id : true; };

try { if (tok.mesh) tok.mesh.alpha = a; } catch (e) {}

tk.add(hold);

}

bodyTrack(total, cfg.bodyZ); particleTrack(total);

if (gate != null) once(gate, () => oni.fireDone());

const byUuid = new Map(); for (let i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) { const d = targets[i].document; if (d) byUuid.set(d.uuid, FOES[i]); }

list.forEach((k, i) => {

const at = i * cfg.gap, f = ftOf(k), pt = { x: f.x - DIR * 14 * KP, y: f.y - 6 * KP }, hitAt = at + 240 + cfg.plunge;

floorShadow(at, hitAt, pt, { r: 34, grow: 240 });

fly(at + 240, { x: pt.x - DIR * 240 * KP, y: top - 140 * KP }, { x: pt.x, y: pt.y - 30 * KP }, { ms: cfg.plunge, ease: X.in, draw: WIND_SPEAR, trail: windTrail, stay: 800 });

once(hitAt, () => oni.hit());

last = hitAt;

});

gate = last; total = last + 800 + 400;

if (MOVE === 'talon' || MOVE === 'lance') {

const tk = FOES[0];

if (!tk) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const isL = MOVE === 'lance', WU = isL ? 450 : 220, FL = isL ? 300 : 240, HIT = WU + FL;

S_(WU, 'wind7', 0.5);

fly(WU, handOf(bodyAt(WU)), tc, { ms: FL, draw: (g) => sp(g), trail: (at, x, y) => part({ t0: at, life: 200, x, y, layer: 'field', draw: (g, px, py, u) => glw(g, px, py, 6 * KP, '255,255,255', 0.5 * (1 - u)) }) });

fx('pierce', HIT, tc, 1, { z: 30 });

S_(WU, 'wind1', 0.5);

const draw = (g, age) => { sp(g); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,255,200,.7)'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(-30 - i * 30, 0, 10, 16, 0, age / 40 + i, age / 40 + i + 3.4); g.stroke(); } };

}

S_(HIT, 'hitpierceb', 0.5);

once(HIT, () => oni.hit());

gate = HIT + 200; total = gate + (isL ? 400 : 300);

await runShot(total, gate);

`;

// Wind Lance — PIERCE (Resolution)

// Pierce: if the action MISSES, still deal 50% damage (round up) as Air damage.

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][PIERCE]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// --- Accuracy (pipeline-first, then args fallback) ---

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

// IMPORTANT: match pipeline "spellish => use magic defense"

const isSpellish =

(typeof args.isSpellish === "boolean") ? args.isSpellish :

(typeof p?.meta?.isSpellish === "boolean") ? p.meta.isSpellish :

false;

const getDefense = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

if (isSpellish) {

// Magic defense snapshot (preferred), actor fallback

return Number(row?.mdef ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.magic_defense ?? 0) || 0;

} else {

// Physical defense snapshot (preferred), actor fallback

return Number(row?.def ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

}

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const usedDef = getDefense(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true; // no accuracy check -> always "hit" for side effects

if (autoHit) return true; // auto-hit flags

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= usedDef; // same rule as applyDamage-button

};

// --- Planned damage (same "planned" math pattern used in your doc) ---

const ap = p?.advPayload ?? p?.actionContext?.advPayload ?? {};

const base = parseInt(String(ap?.baseValue ?? "0").replace("+", ""), 10) || 0;

const bonus = Number(ap?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const reduction = Number(ap?.reduction ?? 0) || 0;

const multPct = Number(ap?.multiplier ?? 100) || 100;

const planned = Math.max(0, Math.floor((base + bonus - reduction) * (multPct / 100)));

const pierceDamage = Math.ceil(planned * 0.5);

if (pierceDamage <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No pierce damage to apply", { planned, pierceDamage });

return;

}

const attackerUuid = String(p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? ap?.attackerUuid ?? "");

const ADV = game.macros.getName("AdvanceDamage");

if (!ADV) return console.warn(TAG, `Macro "AdvanceDamage" not found.`);

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

for (const tuuid of targetUuids) {

const td = await fromUuid(tuuid).catch(() => null);

const targetActor = td?.actor ?? td;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const hit = isHit(tuuid, targetActor);

// HIT: do nothing

if (hit) {

console.log(TAG, "HIT — Pierce does nothing", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

usedDefense: getDefense(tuuid, targetActor),

isSpellish

});

continue;

}

// MISS: apply 50% via AdvanceDamage headless injection

const tokenId =

(td?.documentName === "Token" || td?.documentName === "TokenDocument") ? (td?.id ?? td?._id ?? null)

: canvas?.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t?.actor?.id === targetActor.id)?.id ?? null;

if (!tokenId) {

console.warn(TAG, "MISS but cannot resolve tokenId; skipping", { target: targetActor?.name, tuuid });

continue;

}

console.log(TAG, "MISS — Applying Pierce (50%)", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

usedDefense: getDefense(tuuid, targetActor),

isSpellish,

planned,

pierceDamage

});

globalThis.__AUTO = true;

globalThis.__PAYLOAD = {

targetIds: [tokenId],

baseValue: String(pierceDamage),

bonus: 0,

reduction: 0,

multiplier: 100,

valueType: "hp",

elementType: "air",

weaponType: "none_ef",

attackerUuid

};

await ADV.execute();

delete globalThis.__AUTO;

delete globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

}

})();

// ============================================================================

// Custom Logic - Resolution : Rebellion Wing Cleanup

//

// - Deletes the persistent caster sprite (stored via token flag)

// - Restores caster token alpha back to 1.0

// - GM-side authoritative (Resolution phase)

//

// Update (multi-client sync):

// - Uses game.ONI.pseudo.play() to broadcast client-side cleanup:

// * destroy persistent sprite

// * stop idle floater ticker

// * local alpha snap (best effort)

// - GM still performs authoritative TokenDocument updates + flag unset.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][RebellionWing][Cleanup]";

try {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

if (!game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

console.warn(TAG, "ONI Pseudo Animation API not found: game.ONI.pseudo.play");

// We can still do GM-side alpha/flag cleanup, but sprite removal won't broadcast.

}

// --- Resolve attacker (caster) document from payload ---

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attacker_uuid ??

p?.casterUuid ??

p?.caster_uuid ??

null;

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No attackerUuid in payload. Cannot cleanup.");

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

// attackerDoc could be TokenDocument or Actor; prefer TokenDocument if possible

const casterTokenDoc =

attackerDoc?.documentName === "Token" ? attackerDoc :

attackerDoc?.documentName === "TokenDocument" ? attackerDoc :

attackerDoc?.document?.documentName === "TokenDocument" ? attackerDoc.document :

null;

// Fallback: if attackerUuid is Actor, try to use the first active token in current scene

let tokenDoc = casterTokenDoc;

if (!tokenDoc && attackerDoc?.documentName === "Actor") {

const active = attackerDoc?.getActiveTokens?.(true, true) ?? [];

tokenDoc = active?.[0]?.document ?? null;

}

if (!tokenDoc) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve caster TokenDocument from attackerUuid:", attackerUuid);

return;

}

// --- Read the flag written by the animation macro ---

const flag = tokenDoc.getFlag("fabula-ultima-companion", "rebellionWing") ?? null;

const spriteKey = flag?.spriteKey ?? null;

console.log(TAG, "BEGIN", {

attackerUuid,

token: { id: tokenDoc.id, name: tokenDoc.name, uuid: tokenDoc.uuid },

spriteKey,

hasSpriteMap: !!globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES,

});

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

// 1) Broadcast client-side cleanup via Pseudo API (multi-client)

// This removes the persistent sprite + floater ticker on EACH client.

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

const clientCleanupScript = `

const TAG = "[CL-RES][RebellionWing][Cleanup][Client]";

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

const spriteKey = params.spriteKey != null ? String(params.spriteKey) : null;

const forceAlpha = Number(params.forceAlpha ?? 1);

try {

// A) Stop idle floater ticker if present

if (spriteKey && globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS instanceof Map) {

const floater = globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS.get(String(spriteKey));

if (floater?.ticker && floater?.update) {

try {

floater.ticker.remove(floater.update);

console.log(TAG, "Floater ticker removed:", spriteKey);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to remove floater ticker:", spriteKey, e);

}

}

globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS.delete(String(spriteKey));

}

// B) Destroy sprite object on this client

if (spriteKey && globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES instanceof Map) {

const sprite = globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES.get(String(spriteKey));

if (sprite) {

try {

// Use simple destroy (safe) — avoid destroying shared textures

sprite.destroy();

console.log(TAG, "Sprite destroyed:", spriteKey);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to destroy sprite:", spriteKey, e);

}

globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES.delete(String(spriteKey));

} else {

console.warn(TAG, "No sprite found in __ONI_RW_SPRITES for key:", spriteKey);

}

} else {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing spriteKey or __ONI_RW_SPRITES map; sprite not removed.");

}

// C) Best-effort local alpha snap (no visibility toggles)

// The authoritative alpha comes from TokenDocument update (GM), but this makes it feel instant.

if (casterToken) {

try {

if (casterToken?.mesh) casterToken.mesh.alpha = forceAlpha;

if (casterToken?.icon) casterToken.icon.alpha = forceAlpha;

casterToken.alpha = forceAlpha;

} catch (_) {}

try { casterToken.renderFlags?.set?.({ refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {}

try { casterToken.refresh?.(); } catch (_) {}

}

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "Client cleanup crashed:", err);

}

`;

// Fire-and-forget broadcast; do not block the resolution pipeline.

if (game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

try {

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "cl.res.rebellionWingCleanup",

scriptSource: clientCleanupScript,

casterTokenUuid: tokenDoc.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: {

spriteKey: spriteKey ?? null,

forceAlpha: 1,

},

meta: { source: "CL-RES Rebellion Wing Cleanup" },

});

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "pseudo.play threw (continuing):", e);

}

}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

// 2) GM authoritative: restore TokenDocument alpha to 1.0

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

try {

await tokenDoc.update({ alpha: 1.0 }, { animate: false }).catch(() => tokenDoc.update({ alpha: 1.0 }));

console.log(TAG, "Token alpha restored to 1.0");

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to restore token alpha:", e);

}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

// 3) Optional: clear the flag so it doesn't get reused accidentally

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

try {

await tokenDoc.unsetFlag("fabula-ultima-companion", "rebellionWing");

console.log(TAG, "Token flag cleared: fabula-ultima-companion.rebellionWing");

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to clear flag (non-fatal):", e);

}

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "CRASHED:", err);

}

})();

const TAG = "[CL-RES][DraconicRoar]";

const args = p.__confirmArgs || {}; // applyDamage-button injects this :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}
