};

const getLevel = (actor) =>

Number(actor?.system?.props?.level ?? actor?.system?.level ?? 0) || 0;

// Prefer your pipeline snapshot first (fast + consistent)

const getMDefFromSnapshot = (targetUuid) => {

const list = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget;

if (!Array.isArray(list)) return null;

const row = list.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return num(row?.mdef);

};

// Fallback: read from actor data directly

const readMagicDefense = (actor) => {

const props = actor?.system?.props ?? actor?.system ?? {};

return (

num(props.magic_defense) ??

num(props.current_mdef) ??

num(props.mdef) ??

0

);

};

const pickRandom = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

// ---------- resolve caster ----------

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

args?.attackerUuid ??

null;

const attackerDoc = attackerUuid ? await fromUuid(attackerUuid).catch(() => null) : null;

const casterActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!casterActor) return console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve caster actor.");

const casterLevel = getLevel(casterActor);

// ---------- accuracy total (best sources) ----------

// 1) payload.accuracy.total (from ActionDataComputation)

// 2) confirm args accuracyTotal (from CreateActionCard button)

const accTotal =

num(p?.accuracy?.total) ??

num(args?.accuracyTotal) ??

null;

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

// auto-hit rules (match your confirm behavior style)

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const targets = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targets.length) return console.warn(TAG, "No targets in payload.");

// ---------- debuff pools ----------

const BASIC_DEBUFF_POOL = [

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.nGDTBPQ9omhKG3rM",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.OYLYpaZMWDFRMPgk",

casterLevel,

accTotal,

autoHit,

hasDefenseSnapshot: !!p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot

mdef,

const airT = tw(0, [[C.leap, cfg.leapMs, 330, X.outCubic], [C.leap + cfg.leapMs, cfg.follow, 210, X.sine], [C.back, 520, cfg.hover, X.sine],

[C.gate, 500, cfg.hover + 8, X.sine], [C.gate + 500, 500, cfg.hover, X.sine], [C.gate + 1000, 500, cfg.hover + 8, X.sine], [C.gate + 1500, 500, cfg.hover, X.sine],

[C.gate + 2000, cfg.settle, 0, X.sine]]);

const sxT = tw(1, [[C.squash, 140, 1.1, X.out], [C.leap, 160, 1, X.out], [C.flare, 160, 1.06, X.out], [C.beat, cfg.beat, 1.08, X.out], [C.form, 10, 1, X.out]]);

const syT = tw(1, [[C.squash, 140, 0.85, X.out], [C.leap, 160, 1, X.out], [C.flare, 160, 0.96, X.out], [C.beat, cfg.beat, 0.9, X.out], [C.form, 10, 1, X.out]]);

// the green glow builds over the strands and stays until the form flash; motion blur on the launch and the beat

const glowT = (t) => (t >= C.form ? 0 : X.sine(seg(t, C.strands, C.strands + 700)));

BODY = (t) => {

const k = glowT(t); let f = '';

if (k > 0.001) f += 'drop-shadow(0 0 {' + (10 * k).toFixed(2) + '} rgba(' + WING + ',.9)) brightness(' + (1 - 0.25 * k).toFixed(3) + ')';

else if (t >= C.beat && t < C.beat + cfg.beat + 60) f += ' blur({1.5})';

afterimages(C.leap, C.leap + cfg.leapMs, 35, 0.55, 420, G);

afterimages(C.leap + cfg.leapMs, C.leap + cfg.leapMs + cfg.follow, 110, 0.25, 600, G);

afterimages(C.unfold, C.unfold + cfg.unfold, 90, 0.3, 500, G);

{ let cx = REST.cx, cy = REST.cy;

S_(C.strands, 'charging', 0.5);

fx('strand', C.strands, bodyMid(bodyAt(C.strands)), 1.3, { z: 22 });

// ── dragon / bat energy wings: arm (shoulder, elbow, wrist), four finger bones, a scalloped membrane; translucent energy

// with bright bones; every pose of the last 16 frames is drawn softer behind (motion blur) ──

const D = cfg.unfold;

const wingAt = (t) => {

const te = X.sine(seg(t, C.unfold, C.unfold + D));

const sh = { x: b.x + side * b.w * 0.08, y: b.bottom - b.h * 0.66 };

const up = lerp(-1.25, -0.55, st.open) + st.beat * 0.95, spread = lerp(0.15, 1, st.open);

g.lineWidth = 1.3 * KP; for (const f of fingers) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(wr.x, wr.y); g.lineTo(f.x, f.y); g.stroke(); }

m.hold(C.unfold, C.form, (e, S) => { const t = e + C.unfold; S.world.push({ z: 3, draw: (g) => {

drawWings(g, bodyAt(t), wingAt(t), 1); } }); });

S_(C.unfold, 'wind7', 0.45);

for (let kk = 1; kk <= 8; kk++) { const te = 0.12 * kk + 0.001; if (te >= 1) break; const at = C.unfold + D * Math.acos(1 - 2 * te) / Math.PI; twinkles(at, bodyMid(bodyAt(at)), { n: 2, r: 90 * X.outCubic(Math.min(1, te * 1.15)) + 20, rgb: WING }); }

shake(BH, 8, 300); S_(BH, 'execution', 0.6);

await runShot(total, C.gate);

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 26400);

const CFG = {"casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"volume":0.9,"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"move":"jump","guest":{"squash":0.8,"squashMs":160,"holdMs":220,"releaseMs":120,"upMs":220,"peakMs":700,"diveMs":170,"backMs":400,"apex":260,"landFrac":0.72,"slideMs":450,"lateral":600,"ghosts":5,"lagMs":20,"ghostA":0.6},"seed":4402};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{},"images":{},"sfx":{"jump2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HighJump.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-masked-jump";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Jump]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

// Every client snaps its own mesh at once (the shot still owns her body, so nothing pops); ONE GM (the active GM)

// persists it on the TokenDocument, as the old scripts did; the local value is held until the document agrees.

const isHostGM = () => { const u = game.user; if (!u || !u.isGM) return false; const a = game.users && game.users.activeGM; return a ? a.id === u.id : true; };

function tokenAlpha(tok, a) {

if (!tok) return;

try { if (tok.mesh) tok.mesh.alpha = a; } catch (e) {}

if (isHostGM()) { try { const p = tok.document.update({ alpha: a }, { animate: false }); if (p && p.catch) p.catch((e) => console.warn('[MG] alpha update failed', e)); } catch (e) { console.warn('[MG] alpha update threw', e); } }

const tk = canvas.app && canvas.app.ticker; if (!tk) return; const t0 = performance.now();

const hold = () => { let docA = 1; try { docA = Number(tok.document.alpha); } catch (e) {} if (tok.destroyed || !tok.mesh || Math.abs(docA - a) < 0.01 || performance.now() - t0 > 4000) { tk.remove(hold); return; } try { tok.mesh.alpha = a; } catch (e) {} };

tk.add(hold);

}

// run the shot: damage gate at 'gate' (null = at the end), the start hook on the first frame

async function runShot(total, gate) {

bodyTrack(total, cfg.bodyZ); particleTrack(total);

if (gate != null) once(gate, () => oni.fireDone());

await tl.run(T, { total, sfx, onStart: () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } } });

oni.fireDone();

}

// ── shot ──

// ── Jump / Skyfall Dive / Dragonfire Dive: guest Kalina's dive code and numbers (GUEST cfg, mockup r3), mirrored for

// her side, with the new sprites (r4: dive-landing on the way down and on impact, the float pose on the arc home;

// r6: her battle sprite again the moment she touches down, then the slide). cfg.move = 'jump' | 'skyfall' | 'dragonfire'.

// The token contract kept from the shipped Jump / Skyfall Dive: Jump leaves her token at alpha 0 (hidden while Flying,

// persisted on the TokenDocument by one GM); Skyfall Dive starts hidden and sets it back to 1 when she lands.

const MOVE = cfg.move, G = cfg.guest;

const top = viewTop();

const liftOff = (y) => (y - top) + 340 * KP; // mockup OY(t) + 340: from her floor row to above the frame

let total = 0, gate = 0;

if (MOVE === 'jump') {

// a quick crouch (squash to 80 %), then she launches off the top of the frame

const C0 = G.squashMs, C1 = C0 + G.holdMs, C2 = C1 + G.releaseMs, UP = C2 + G.upMs;

const syT = tw(1, [[0, G.squashMs, G.squash, X.outCubic], [C1, G.releaseMs, 1, X.inCubic]]);

const airT = tw(0, [[C2, G.upMs, liftOff(kf.y), X.outCubic]]);

BODY = (t) => ({ sy: syT(t), air: airT(t), hidden: t >= UP });

S_(C2, 'jump2', 0.5); dustBurst(C2, kf, { n: 8 });

// hidden while Flying: every client drops its mesh to 0 as she leaves the frame, one GM persists it

once(UP, () => tokenAlpha(caster, 0));

gate = UP; total = UP + 400;

}

if (MOVE === 'skyfall' || MOVE === 'dragonfire') {

const winged = MOVE === 'dragonfire';

const tk = FOES[0] || null;

// Skyfall: she is already up there (hidden since Jump), a hold in the sky. Dragonfire: take off in the winged form first.

let D0 = G.peakMs, airUp = null;

if (winged) { const up = tw(0, [[0, G.upMs, liftOff(kf.y), X.outCubic]]); airUp = (t) => up(t); D0 = G.upMs + Math.round(G.peakMs * 0.6); S_(0, 'wind1', 0.5); }

if (!tk) {

// no target: nothing to dive at; bring her back as she is

BODY = (t) => (winged ? { pose: 'winged', air: airUp(t), hidden: t >= G.upMs } : { hidden: true });

if (!winged) once(0, () => tokenAlpha(caster, 1));

total = winged ? G.upMs + 300 : 300; gate = total;

} else {

const tf = ftOf(tk), home = { x: kf.x, y: kf.y };

const startX = tf.x - DIR * G.lateral * KP, hitX = tf.x - DIR * 30 * KP;

const IMP = D0 + G.diveMs, BACK0 = IMP + 140, LAND = BACK0 + G.backMs, SLID = LAND + G.slideMs, STOP = SLID + G.ghosts * G.lagMs + 60;

const landX = lerp(tf.x, home.x, G.landFrac), l0 = liftOff(tf.y);

const pDown = winged ? 'winged' : 'diveland', pBack = winged ? 'winged' : 'jump', pLand = winged ? 'winged' : 'idle';

BODY = (t) => {

if (t < D0) return winged ? { pose: 'winged', air: airUp(t), hidden: t >= G.upMs } : { hidden: true };

if (t < IMP) { const u = X.inCubic(seg(t, D0, IMP)); return { pose: pDown, x: lerp(startX, hitX, u), y: tf.y, air: lerp(l0, 0, u) }; }

if (t < BACK0) return { pose: pDown, x: hitX, y: tf.y };

if (t < LAND) { const u = seg(t, BACK0, LAND); return { pose: pBack, x: lerp(hitX, landX, u), y: lerp(tf.y, home.y, u), air: G.apex * 4 * u * (1 - u) * KP }; }

return { pose: pLand, x: lerp(landX, home.x, X.outCubic(seg(t, LAND, SLID))), y: home.y };

};

// five-ghost blue-to-black trail from the dive start until she settles

TRAILS.push({ t0: D0, t1: SLID, n: G.ghosts, lag: G.lagMs, op: G.ghostA, pose: pDown });

S_(D0, 'wind7', 0.5);

const tc = center(tk);

if (!winged) {

fx('impact10', IMP, tc, 1.4, { z: 40 }); S_(IMP, 'hitslashb', 0.7); shake(IMP, 10, 300);

} else {

const tb = boxB(tk), th = TOK[tk].h;

fx('fireball', IMP, { x: tf.x, y: tb - th * 0.35 }, 1.5, { z: 40 });

fx('bomb', IMP, tf, 1.2, { z: 41, add: true });

fx('bombBottom', IMP, tf, 1.2, { z: 3, add: true });

flashC(IMP, '#ffb060', 0.5, 30, 260); shake(IMP, 22, 520); ring(IMP, tf, { rgb: '255,160,60', r1: 320, w: 12, ms: 700 });

for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) ember(IMP, tf.x + rnd(-120, 120) * KP, tf.y - rnd(0, 120) * KP, '255,140,50', { vy: -rnd(0.1, 0.3), r: rnd(3, 7) });

S_(IMP, 'explosion2', 0.7); S_(IMP, 'fire3', 0.5);

}

// the contact: the game shows the hurt, the flinch and the numbers (splash targets included)

once(IMP, () => oni.hit());

// feet on the ground: battle sprite again, a puff of dust, then the slide home; Skyfall hands her back to the token

dustBurst(LAND, { x: landX, y: home.y }, { n: 6 });

if (!winged) once(LAND, () => tokenAlpha(caster, 1));

gate = STOP; total = STOP + (winged ? 500 : 300);

}

}

await runShot(total, gate);

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Skyfall Dive" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

// ============================================================================

// Custom Logic - Action

// If caster has Active Effect "Flying", add +10 bonus damage.

// Priority: match by Effect ID (from provided UUID) -> fallback match by name "Flying"

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][FLYING->BONUS10]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// 1) Resolve attacker/caster actor

const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";

const attackerDoc = attackerUuid ? await fromUuid(attackerUuid) : null;

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

return console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor from UUID:", attackerUuid);

}

// 2) Your provided ActiveEffect UUID (ID-first matching)

const FLYING_EFFECT_UUID =

"Actor.LnlydRl7Ed7agd1g.Item.yfZbxLNZwsy6lcW0.ActiveEffect.2bUi37PPeGTeuymZ";

// Extract the actual ActiveEffect ID (last segment)

const flyingEffectId = String(FLYING_EFFECT_UUID).split(".").pop();

// 3) Check for Flying effect:

// A) by ID

// B) fallback by name "Flying" (case-insensitive)

const effects = attackerActor.effects; // ActiveEffect collection

const hasById = flyingEffectId ? !!effects?.get(flyingEffectId) : false;

const hasByName = !hasById

? Array.from(effects ?? []).some((ef) => String(ef?.name ?? "").toLowerCase() === "flying")

: false;

const hasFlying = hasById || hasByName;

if (!hasFlying) {

return console.log(TAG, "No Flying effect found — no bonus applied.", {

attacker: attackerActor.name,

checkedEffectId: flyingEffectId,

});

}

// 4) Apply +10 bonus damage

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const before = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = before + 10;

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED +10 bonus damage", {

attacker: attackerActor.name,

match: hasById ? "id" : "name",

bonusBefore: before,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus,

});

})();
